Container.Name: messenger-web
Container.Overview:
One web interface for Signal and WhatsApp. Links to your phone as a linked device on each network (through the signal-api container for Signal and WAHA for WhatsApp), stores your chat history locally, and serves a password-protected web UI.
Needs signal-cli-rest-api (MODE=json-rpc or json-rpc-native) and/or WAHA (devlikeapro/waha:chrome with the WEBJS engine). Set SIGNAL_API_URL to off to use WhatsApp only, or leave WAHA URL empty for Signal only. See the project README.
Container.Requires: signal-cli-rest-api and/or WAHA, reachable from this container (for example on the host's IP in bridge mode).

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Password for the web interface. At least 8 characters; use a long one.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Chat history database and attachments.

Config.Name: Intel video chip (Quick Sync)
Config.Description: Optional: /dev/dri makes converting videos several times faster on an Intel processor with graphics (Quick Sync). The folder must exist on Unraid (Intel GPU TOP plugin, or i915 loaded); leave empty otherwise.

Config.Name: Signal API URL
Config.Description: Address of the signal-api container, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8739 in bridge mode. Set to off to run without Signal.

Config.Name: WAHA URL
Config.Description: Address of your WAHA container, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:6523. Leave empty to run without WhatsApp.

Config.Name: WAHA API key
Config.Description: WAHA's API key (WAHA_API_KEY in the WAHA container, or the key printed in its log on first start).

Config.Name: WAHA session
Config.Description: WAHA session name. Messenger Web creates it if it doesn't exist.

Config.Name: WhatsApp history: chats
Config.Description: How many recent WhatsApp chats to import once after linking.

Config.Name: WhatsApp history: messages per chat
Config.Description: How many recent messages to import per chat.

Config.Name: Giphy API key
Config.Description: Enables the GIF picker. Create a free key at developers.giphy.com (Create an App, choose API).

Config.Name: Giphy rating
Config.Description: Content rating for GIF search results.

Config.Name: Send read receipts
Config.Description: Tell senders when you've read their messages in Messenger Web.

Config.Name: Send typing indicators
Config.Description: Show others when you're typing.

Config.Name: Send link previews
Config.Description: When you type a link, fetch the page to send a preview (the site sees your server's address).

Config.Name: TLS certificate file
Config.Description: Optional: path inside the container to a PEM certificate (chain), e.g. /data/tls/cert.pem. With the key below, Messenger Web serves HTTPS, which browsers require for notifications.

Config.Name: TLS key file
Config.Description: Optional: path inside the container to the PEM private key, e.g. /data/tls/key.pem.

Config.Name: Secure cookies (HTTPS)
Config.Description: Set to true when you reach Messenger Web over HTTPS (e.g. via a reverse proxy).

Config.Name: Signal number
Config.Description: Only needed if the signal-api container holds more than one account.

Config.Name: Max upload (MB)
Config.Description: Largest attachment you can send.

Config.Name: Session length (days)
Config.Description: How long a browser stays signed in.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the files in /data.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the files in /data.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for log timestamps.
